objective: Before any v0.3.2 publication, perform a read-only provenance audit of the unexpected public @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.9.0 / latest state, fix the stale candidate-version pin in the authoritative npm install verifier, harden Windows failed-job worktree cleanup so retained state and cleanup warnings are truthful under transient/persistent locks, and establish non-secret OpenCode Go credential readiness for the later mandatory live worker/reviewer gate.
context: Issue #45 tracks this batch. The prior TASK-V032-FULL-FUNCTION-ACCEPTANCE completed BLOCKED only because real worker/reviewer attempts reached configured provider opencode-alt but llm-pi-ai reported OPENCODE_ALT_API_KEY not set. All other major surfaces passed: 434/434 deterministic tests, build, packed candidate default npm install, official DSH cohort audit, installed Crew DSH runtime/web/Hub, MCP stdio/tools, session config, async jobs/cancel/failure propagation, routing/model catalog, workspace isolation, Codex and Claude integrations. validation: After checkout main + git pull --ff-only, validate this Task Contract with node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs task docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json; record resolved source SHA and require clean baseline.

READ-ONLY NPM PROVENANCE AUDIT: query the public registry with explicit registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ for @ran-sh/dsh-crew dist-tags, versions, publication times, maintainers/owners where publicly exposed, and per-version metadata for 0.3.0, 0.3.1, and 0.9.0. For 0.9.0 record only non-secret fields such as name/version, repository/homepage, gitHead, _npmUser name/email if public, dist integrity/shasum/tarball URL, engines/files, and publish time. Never print auth config or tokens.

Treat 0.9.0 as untrusted data. If deeper inspection is needed, download/package-fetch it without executing lifecycle scripts, extract into a disposable directory, and inspect package.json/README/CHANGELOG/source metadata only. Do NOT npm install it and do NOT execute its binaries/scripts. Remove the disposable directory afterward.

Audit the local Git repository across ALL refs, not only main: tags, remote branches, and `git log --all`/object reachability for any 0.9.0 package/version history and for the 0.9.0 registry gitHead if present. Determine whether the registry artifact is provably sourced from this repository. Classify provenance explicitly as MATCHED_REPO, SAME_PUBLISHER_UNMATCHED_REPO, DIFFERENT_PUBLISHER, INSUFFICIENT_METADATA, or other equally precise fail-closed classification. A provenance conclusion may not be inferred from package scope/name alone.

Compare public publisher metadata for known-good 0.3.1 vs 0.9.0 when available. If 0.9.0 is not provably tied to this repo/known release history, do not mutate npm to 'fix' it; mark release safety BLOCKED and give exact recommended human/account-security follow-up in the Result.

Fix scripts/verify-npm-install.mjs so the authoritative candidate version is derived from the candidate package manifest/current package identity rather than a stale hard-coded 0.3.1 literal. Keep exact package/runtime identity checks, bounded official DSH cohort audit, normal npm resolver behavior, and fail-closed semantics. Remove version-specific temp/user-agent labels where they can silently go stale. Add regression tests proving a 0.3.2 manifest passes its own version guard, mismatched installed/runtime versions fail, and the verifier does not require editing source constants for the next candidate version.

Run node --test test/verify-npm-install.test.mjs. Then run pnpm run verify:npm-install and require NPM_INSTALL_CONTRACT=PASS candidate=0.3.2; run pnpm run verify:npm-install:official and require DSH_COHORT_AUDIT=PASS official_dsh=0.1.1-rc.2 plus NPM_INSTALL_CONTRACT=PASS candidate=0.3.2. No manual-equivalent fallback is acceptable after the fix.

Diagnose the Windows failed-worktree cleanup truthfulness bug. Reproduce deterministically with injected git/fs runners where possible: transient first remove failure/lock then success, and persistent lock/failure. Implement the smallest bounded retry/backoff or cleanup sequencing fix needed. On eventual success, report retained=false with no stale worktree. On persistent cleanup failure, report retained=true and a non-empty cleanup_warning/reason; never claim cleanup success while a worktree remains registered/on disk. Keep primary workspace safety invariants intact.

Add/update focused tests in workspace-isolation/workflow runtime suites for transient Windows lock recovery, persistent lock truthfulness, failed-job cleanup, cancellation cleanup, and no accidental deletion of allowed/primary worktrees. Ensure retry count/time is bounded and tests do not sleep excessively.
Run targeted workspace tests: node --test test/workspace-isolation.test.mjs test/workflow-runtime.test.mjs test/workflow.test.mjs. Require zero failures.
Run full deterministic suite node --test test/*.test.mjs; require zero failures. Run pnpm run build:client and restore deterministic tracked build side effects. Run git diff --check.

Run npm pack --dry-run --json and npm publish --dry-run --access public only (strictly non-mutating) for the local 0.3.2 candidate. Confirm no task/result/test/temp/secret payload leaks. Do NOT perform a real publish.

NON-SECRET OPENCODE READINESS: if `opencode` is available, run `opencode --version`, `opencode auth list` (or `opencode auth ls`), and `opencode models`/provider-filtered models as needed. Record provider/model identities only; never open auth.json or print key/token values. Determine whether an authenticated OpenCode Go provider and DeepSeek V4 Flash/Pro models are visible. If clearly authenticated and a tiny non-interactive smoke can be run without config mutation, run one bounded `opencode run --model <discovered-provider/model> --format json` prompt that performs no filesystem writes and record success/failure without sensitive response data. Do not change DSH/Crew provider config in this task.

Final machine check is read-only/idempotent only: node scripts/setup.mjs status must still show DSH plugin installed, Codex Desktop integration installed, Claude Code integration installed. Do not uninstall/purge. Confirm no acceptance Hub ports/processes/worktrees are left behind by this task.

Write schema-v2 Result Contract to docs/agent-results/TASK-V032-RELEASE-SAFETY-HARDENING-result.json. Include: provenance classification and evidence, current public dist-tags/version timeline, verifier fix evidence, worktree cleanup fix evidence, OpenCode readiness outcome, all tests, blockers, and final_machine_state: INSTALLED. Stamp/validate result, delete ACTIVE_TASK, commit/push only authorized completion changes, then stop.
